notes: Printed names: 'HOLLISTER', 'AUBURN AV.', 'McCORMICK PL.' and 'McGREGOR AV.' and 'ALBION PL.' (stubs on the east side, from sheets 192/183), 'WELLINGTON PL.', 'INWOOD PL.' (both arms), 'GLENCOE PL. (MITCHELL AV.)' (old name Mitchell Avenue; sheet 183 records this junction as 'Mitchell Avenue'), 'DERONDE AV.', 'DAN', 'VIEW COURT (EAST VIEW)', 'LEROY CT. (ERIE AV.)', 'MAIN'. Hollister, Dan and Main written with 'Street'. All Auburn junctions are T: Hollister, Wellington and Glencoe from the west, McCormick, McGregor and Albion from the east; Auburn's centre taken on the middle of its three pipe lines, which matches the midpoint of its block lines. Leroy Ct. meets Main (east line x ~778, west line starts at y ~4003 where the unopened 25 ft Main strip of sheet 181 ends) as a T at Main's north end. Dan/Leroy is an L corner (Leroy stops at Dan, Dan stops at Leroy), recorded as T. Deronde runs Glencoe to Leroy. Inwood Pl. horizontal arm ~27 ft, vertical arm ~31 ft with a '35' figure printed in it (width uncertain, not recorded). Unnamed 10 ft alley between the two row-house rows from Deronde to Dan. Water-pipe dashed lines around the Deronde/Leroy/Dan block are pipes, not a court boundary. West of the Taft Park line (x ~750-778) is Taft Park / sheet 189 and 181.
